title: Q-LESSON-METRIC-FRESH: Every metric has a producer and a fresh reading
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::stale_metric
**Status:** open

LESSONS-1 (2026-11-16): from the failure-mode register of the fleet this org was split from (638 entries, classified by root cause).

18 failure modes were metrics registered with no producer or a refresher that stopped, and the class was rising in November.

Path: seed/worker/src/tick.js

Acceptance: tick.js measure files a liveness breach for a metric whose last reading is older than twice its cadence, and a test asserts every metric row names a producer.

size: S

**Closing probe:** grep:seed/worker/src/tick.js::stale_metric

**Evidence:** pending
